messages:
maria (product): Heads up — we need a crisp mapping for client-facing status + error payloads before the routing rollout. UX team wants stable labels in the console and the SDKs need consistent retry hints.
jamal (eng): Agreed. Big question: do we rely solely on HTTP codes or add a small, stable top-level error envelope like {public_code, internal_code, message, retry_after}?
olivia (console): Please add public_code. The console dashboard needs a short, non-technical badge string (e.g., ROUTE_QUOTA, FALLBACK_ACTIVE) for filtering and alerts.
kevin (devex): SDKs will love a stable public_code. Prefer ALL_CAPS short tokens. Also include a machine-readable field for telemetry ingestion (e.g., telemetry_tags: ["routing=fallback","tier=gold"]).
alex (sre): Important: we mustn't conflate 429 (rate limit) and 503 (capacity/unavailable). They mean different remediation. 429 -> backoff, 503 -> fallback or degrade. Can we standardize semantics: 429 = client throttled, 503 = server degraded or model unavailable, 202/204 not relevant.
jamal (eng): +1. Proposal: http status maps + public_code mapping: 429 -> ROUTE_QUOTA_EXCEEDED ; 503 -> ROUTE_CAPACITY_ISSUE ; 502/504 -> UPSTREAM_FAILURE ; 409 -> VERSION_MISMATCH (when pinned model missing) ; 400 -> BAD_REQUEST_DETAILS.
maria (product): That sounds reasonable. We also need a way to signal a "soft fallback" where we served a lower-capacity cheaper model successfully (not an error). How to show that?
kevin (devex): Soft fallback shouldn't be an error status. Keep 200 OK, but add header X-Redwood-Fallback: "model:rw-medium, reason:capacity" and public_code: FALLBACK_SERVED. SDKs can emit a telemetry event on that header. Console can show a yellow badge.
olivia (console): Perfect. For console UX: errors get red cards, fallback events are amber with an info tooltip showing exact model and latency delta. We need a single public_code taxonomy across console + SDKs + docs.
ajamal (eng): (typo: jamal) I pushed a small JSON schema draft for the error envelope to the repo, gist below: 
```
{
  "public_code": "ROUTE_QUOTA_EXCEEDED",
  "internal_code": "RTE.QT.EXCEEDED_v2",
  "message": "Your request exceeded the per-route token quota.",
  "retry_after": 45,          // seconds, optional
  "help_url": "https://docs.redwood.ai/errors#ROUTE_QUOTA_EXCEEDED",
  "telemetry_tags": ["routing=primary","tier=standard"],
  "meta": {"route_id":"r-1234"} // internal-only, strip for public docs
}
```

kevin (devex): One ask: avoid nested objects in public payloads. meta is fine as stringified JSON but ideally keep top-level flat keys to avoid SDK parsing surprises.
alex (sre): For telemetry/metrics we should include a stable tag: error_kind: [quota, capacity, fallback, upstream, config]. Also include routing_policy: [latency, cost, region]. That will make dashboards consistent.
maria (product): Action items: 1) Jamal to update schema to flatten meta into meta_str, 2) Olivia to draft console badge mapping (red/amber/green) + tooltip text, 3) Kevin to add SDK parsing + telemetry event spec, 4) Alex to define dashboard tiles and alert thresholds.
jamal (eng): Will do. Also: rollout plan — start with canary tenants (beta orgs) and a short A/B where console shows old vs new badges. Need a feature flag.
olivia (console): Put flag under experiments.console.error_taxonomy_v1. Console team will subscribe to flag.
deploy-bot: "deploy trigger: canary-feature-flag error-taxonomy-v1 enabled for orgs: beta-*, test-*"
maria (product): Timeline: RFC by EOW, canary roll next Tue, full rollout after two weeks if telemetry looks good.
kevin (devex): Small nit: retry_after semantics — prefer seconds integer. SDKs should do jittered backoff based on retry_after when present, otherwise use exponential backoff. I'll add code samples.
ajamal (eng): (fixing my earlier typo) Also recommend header hints: `X-Redwood-Error: ROUTE_QUOTA_EXCEEDED; retry=45` and `Retry-After` for 429.
alex (sre): For alarms: treat ROUTE_CAPACITY_ISSUE as P1 if >2% of requests in a region in 5m window. Fallback events are P2 unless error rate spikes. I'll write alert rules.
olivia (console): One more: localization. public_code stays English-tokenized but message text must be localizable. We'll pass message_id keys for i18n.
maria (product): Great. If no objections, I'll create the RFC and assign owners. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
kevin (devex): :+1:
ajamal (eng): 👍
